message: 信念への挑戦状

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President♪ Let's walk home together~」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, yeah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The shooting stars... They're so pretty~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, they are.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「More of these shooting stars fall as Re-Crea gets closer, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What were you talking about... with Azel today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And you had a super serious look on your face, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I don't think that's true at all.\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. It's useless to hide it. Because you're awful at keeping secrets, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-no... It's not really hiding anything, or how should I put it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're lovers, so no keeping secrets!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, it's not a secret!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so~~ And here I was getting all excited thinking it was a secret~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Should I hide it or not? What am I even supposed to do...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, you only ever talk to Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-what's wrong with that? Azel's my friend too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That may be true, but... but... I want to talk with you a whole lot too, Mr. President...」
I thought she was sharp, but maybe she's just jealous...

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. We'll always be together from now on, Lolotte, so we can talk all we want.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, what were you talking about with Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh.」
Well, I never intended to dodge the question in the first place...

name: Synn
message: 「Listen carefully, Lolotte. Stay calm and hear me out. Actually--」
I tell her the story I heard from Azel, just as it was told to me.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So that's why this shooting star...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I honestly thought you already knew when you asked.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even I am not an esper, you know.」
Though she says it in a joking tone, a shadow still clouds her expression.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I somehow... had a feeling. Azel-san always tries to shoulder everything alone.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, we have no choice but to do as Azel says...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is there really... really no other way!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what Azel said. Azel confided in us because she trusts us. So, I'm going to trust what she told me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But if she trusts us, couldn't she have told me directly!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why... how could she... keep something like that a secret all this time...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「More than anyone else, Azel probably didn't want to fight with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think she just didn't want to see you sad and suffering, Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san...」

name: Synn
message: 「I think Azel did it out of consideration for you... because her wish is a cruel thing to ask of you as her friend.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why, truthfully, she hesitated to even tell anyone. But the one who gave her the courage to open up--」

name: Synn
message: 「Was without a doubt you, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I did...」

name: Synn
message: 「The courage not to carry it alone, and to confide in someone. Azel hasn't betrayed you.」

name: Synn
message: 「So, we have to...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san... I'm sorry... for not noticing... I'm so, sorry...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...President!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If Azel-san had the courage to confide in us, then I can't afford to lose either!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll have the courage to stand up to Azel-san's conviction!」

name: Synn
message: 「Together... together, we'll take on the will of Re-Crea...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's defeat it together!」
We thrust our arms toward the sky.
And against the countless shooting stars, we declared war.
